The Department of English offers Bachelor of Arts (BA) degrees in English and Film and Media Studies.

At ASU, we believe the best way to prepare students for future work in the highly competitive field of film and media is to give them the critical capacity to adapt to the ever-changing needs of the entertainment industry. Ultimately, we believe that students must integrate theory and practice to build a solid foundation for future success in the media. They must go beyond the classroom and engage with the industry.
